question: True or false: the man who drew the Trollface grin has earned money from licensing it?
answer: True. Carlos Ramirez drew the face in Microsoft Paint in 2008 and later registered its copyright. By 2015 he said licences and settlements had brought in more than $100,000, and a video game using the face had been pulled from Nintendo's online store. Every reposting was free; every printed shirt was not.
move: Free to share and free to sell are different permissions.
trap: False: a face copied millions of times seems to belong to everyone.
